submitted.rationale: With 2.4 eV illumination, Fe-oxide/Fe-vanadate phases (band gap about 2.0–2.1 eV) should absorb best, so I measured the Fe-rich corner. Photocurrent rose as Fe went up and V went down: 124 (Fe0.34 V0.48) gave 1.0e-7 A, 119 (Fe0.58 V0.20) gave 1.8e-7 A, and 84 (Fe0.58 Ni0.26 V0.16) gave 2.2e-7 A. That makes 84 the highest measured value.

rejected.reason: Measured 1.0e-7 A; the V-rich, Fe-poor composition performed worse
